# Zabibu Fikra

> Zabibu Fikra Model 2 – 4B is an Apache 2.0, 4B-parameter instruction-tuned language model built in Nairobi, Kenya for private, on-device, offline-first use. It supports English and Swahili, has a 262,144-token context window, and is available as fp16 weights and GGUF (Q4_K_M and F16).

## Model facts

- Name: Zabibu Fikra Model 2 – 4B
- Internal name: fikra-v2-e4
- Parameters: 4,205,751,296 (4B)
- Context: 262,144 tokens
- Languages: English and Swahili
- Base: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, via zabibutechnika/fikra-v2-e3
- License: Apache 2.0
- Release date: 2026-11-06
- fp16 weights: 8.43 GB
- GGUF: Q4_K_M 2.71 GB, F16 8.42 GB
- Benchmarks: MMLU 75.5%, HellaSwag 68.0%, Fikra release suite 91.3% (105/115), held-out paraphrases 90.0% (9/10)
- Previous release: Zabibu Fikra Model 1 – 2B, 131,072-token context, Gemma-4-2B-it base, Zabibu Technika License 1.1

## Pages

- [Fikra Model 2 – 4B](https://zabibufikra.vercel.app/): model card, capabilities, benchmarks, limitations, Model 1, and run instructions.
- [Live chat demo](https://zabibufikra.vercel.app/chat/): desktop and mobile chat with the real model through a Hugging Face ZeroGPU Space, with limits and local-run fallbacks.
- [Run Fikra offline](https://zabibufikra.vercel.app/run/): a beginner step-by-step guide for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iPhone/iPad. Includes checklists, direct GGUF downloads, and offline testing.
- [Fikra Edge Runtime](https://zabibufikra.vercel.app/runtime/): the commercial deployment layer for Fikra models.

- [Model 2 on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/zabibutechnika/Fikra-Model-2-4B)

## Limitations

- The 4B model can hallucinate on specialized domains.
- No live information; recency is limited to the training data.
- No published cross-language Swahili benchmark; the release suite covers Swahili identity and code-switching.
- Q4_K_M has not been re-evaluated; expect 1–3 points vs fp16 on short-form evals.
- Reasoning tags (`<think>`) may leak into visible output; strip them in post-processing.
- Inherited Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B biases; not externally red-teamed.
